question: As of july 2021 who is the Chief Economist of the International Monetary Fund?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gita Gopinath.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gita Gopinath**__

 __
 
• She is an Indian American economist who has been the **Chief Economist of the IMF since 2019.**
 
• She called the worldwide recession of **2020 "The Great Lockdown".**
 
• In 2019 she has been awarded the Pravasi Bhartiya Samman, the highest honor for a person of Indian origin residing out of India.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund**__
 __
 
• It is an organization of 190 countries working to foster global monetary cooperation secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth and reduce poverty around the world.
 
• **Headquarters**: Washington D.C.
 
• **Managing Director**: Krishtalina Georgieva
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Raghuram Rajan**__

 __
 
• He is an Indian economist.
 
• He was the 23rd Governor of the RBI from 2013 to 2016.
 
• During his tenure at the RBI, he became the Vice Chairman of the Bank for International Settlements.
 
 
 
• **Montek Singh Ahluwalia**__
 __
 
• He is an Indian economist and civil servant who was the Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission of India, a position which carried the rank of a Cabinet Minister.
 
• He was previously the first Director of the Independent Evaluation Office at the International Monetary Fund.
 
 
 
• **Krishna Bhardwa__j**
 
 
• He is an Indian television actor.
 
• He acted in a few short films, such as "I Guess" (2013).
 
• He has also enacted the lead role in a Gujarati movie, Chal Man Jeetva Jaiya.
